 Hunt’s own effort in the genre, The Descent of Liberty, conducted the tricky experiment
of freeing the masque from its aristocratic and conservative bearings whilst taking for its
topic and occasion a victory interpreted by the leaders of the victorious powers as warrant-
ing the restoration of aristocratic and conservative political principles. In his Preface, Hunt
explains that he felt authorised to introduce into the drama the national genii of Great
